prompts.name: 月团
prompts.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG mascot sprite sheet, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells. SAME single character repeated SIX times with identical scale, centered in each cell, same foot baseline, generous 12% clear margin in every cell. Full body seated cute premium soft plush toy, round chubby proportions, tactile short velvety fur, gentle studio lighting, simple glossy black eyes, restrained pastel palette. No background, no floor, no cast shadows, no lettering, no cell borders. Expressions row-major: neutral friendly idle; thoughtful with one paw near cheek; happy smiling; winking; calm patiently waiting; sleepy eyes closed. Keep entire ears, feet, tail within each cell. Character: ivory white lop-eared moon rabbit with a tiny muted gold crescent forehead marking, dusty lavender inner ears
